verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a cloud browser-automation platform, but the pack documents no way to export your account data (sessions, replays, functions, profiles, vault contents) in open formats. The scraping/fetch features that output markdown or structured data concern extracting third-party website content, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
